authorization: Continued work under Pete's latest finish request. The preceding one-fit control experiment is closed, including its failed gates. This separately declared successor follows a measured loss-versus-return discrepancy, not an optimizer sweep.
capability: Learn attack and switching decisions in proportion to their measured consequence, instead of treating near-certain preferred labels as equally costly.
learned_authority: All choices remain learned from authenticated TRAIN returns. No hardcoded move preference, teacher substitution, or final-actor memory edit.
transfer_test: Eight fixed new TRAIN numeric variants, not independent natural transfer. Reuse the proposed-control variant recipes with actor HP 40, opponent HP 58 and all opponents level 30, opening idle 4. Compare frozen and candidate.
cheapest_falsifier: Actual mean-return regret or complete-battle outcomes fail to improve despite changing the objective directly.
time_box: One additional 1200-epoch fit, seed 2026091804, on the same 180 authenticated contexts; no extra collection, parameter sweep or repeated fit. 45 minutes including bounded verification.
stop_condition: At most one candidate execution on the known TRAIN regression plus eight paired variants, each capped at 160 decisions/240000 frames. Retain every result; stop the fitting sequence after this successor regardless of outcome.
objective: Minimize expected regret: sum over candidate probabilities times maximum measured mean return minus that candidate's measured mean return. Mean returns are averaged over recorded timings before optimization. Legacy default cross-entropy behavior remains unchanged.
components: Warm-start attack from the preceding model; fit switch and proposed-action control with the same expected-return objective. Control targets and input proposals use the concrete fitted child heads.
